$comment: Class-wide teacher settings for the Instructor Playbook (all units): the classroom expectations a substitute enforces. Teacher-facing; no student information. Draft until Mr. Bennett approves it.
expectations: Personal phones are checked in when students enter the room.
No earbuds or headphones during speeches.
Stay seated during speeches unless an accommodation or an urgent need requires otherwise.
Wait until the speaker finishes before asking unrelated questions.
No side conversations or distracting expressions.
Students who are speaking dispose of gum beforehand.
accommodations: Follow every student's individual accommodations exactly as provided by the school (for example, in the substitute folder or the student's plan). Approved accommodations are always allowed, including during speeches: presenting seated, extra time, a smaller audience, a scheduled time, or the typed journal option. Do not ask students to explain an accommodation.
contact: For urgent questions, contact the main office.
